project_type: Expo TypeScript mobile app (Expo SDK ~57, React Native 0.86.3)
build_system: npm with expo CLI - uses npx expo install for dependency management, NOT npm install
test_framework: No test framework currently configured - manual testing only
build_command: npx tsc --noEmit (typecheck only, no compilation needed for Expo)
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compilation. 2. Run npx expo lint to check code style. 3. Start dev server with npx expo start. 4. Test on Android emulator or device. 5. Verify offline functionality by enabling airplane mode during testing.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - Expo generates native folders dynamically (Continuous Native Generation)
environment_constraints: Must maintain Expo Go compatibility - no bare native modules beyond already installed ones (expo-sqlite, expo-image-picker, expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-router). Uses localhost:8081 dev server. Android emulator uses 10.0.2.2 for host machine access.
contribution_requirements: ALWAYS use 'npx expo install' instead of npm/yarn/pnpm add for package installation - it resolves SDK-compatible versions. Run npx tsc --noEmit and npx expo lint before completing any task. Keep routes in src/app/, all other code outside. Financial amounts must be in minor units (cents). Use executeTransaction() for all financial operations. Never delete transaction records (soft deletes only). All features must work offline. Use UUIDs for all primary keys.
key_patterns: Repository pattern with singleton exports (see productRepository.ts, categoryRepository.ts). Database access via executeQuery, executeQuerySingle, executeWrite, executeTransaction from src/database/index.ts. Snake_case in DB, camelCase in TypeScript. Row mapping functions convert between conventions. React Hook Form + Zod for forms. TanStack Query v5 for server state. Zustand v5 for local state. Expo Router file-based navigation. SafeAreaView + ScrollView + KeyboardAvoidingView for screen layout. Input/Button components with consistent styling. Constants imported from src/constants/* (colors, spacing, typography).
directory_structure: src/app/ contains Expo Router screens: (auth)/ for auth flows, (tabs)/ for main tabs (index, pos, products, reports, settings). src/components/ has reusable UI (common/ subfolder for Input, Button). src/services/repositories/ holds data access layer. src/database/ contains schema.ts (all 23 table definitions) and index.ts (db operations). src/types/ has all TypeScript interfaces. src/constants/ has colors, spacing, typography, config. src/utils/ has currency, datetime, uuid, validation helpers. src/hooks/ exists but empty - TanStack Query hooks will go here. src/stores/ exists but empty - Zustand cart store will go here.
